subject: Vendor portal retirement & transfer notice - action required
messages:
From: Clara Li <clara.li@vendr.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Upcoming Vendr portal retirement & profile transfer options

Hi Jordan,

Quick note from the Vendr product team: were retiring the legacy portal on June 15, 2027 and consolidating all vendor profiles into our new portal. For customers who currently have a profile on the legacy portal, we can either (A) auto-migrate the existing profile and evidence bundle to the new portal, or (B) hand back a signed evidence bundle and a transfer manifest so you can ingest into another system.

We flagged BrightLeaf Health (account id: BL-9802) and saw an active profile with several SOC2/SIG artifacts. To proceed with an auto-migration we need a named steward and confirmation of two items:

- Preferred migration mode (auto-migrate vs hand-back)
- Delegated steward email + 24-hr window for presigned upload if you pick hand-back

Please let me know who should be the point of contact and whether you want the auto-migrate. If we dont hear back by May 7 we will schedule an auto-migrate with a post-migration validation window.

Attachment: migration-checklist.pdf (summary)

Thanks,
Clara Li
Vendor Integrations — Vendr
[attachment: migration-checklist.pdf (pdf)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Clara Li <clara.li@vendr.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming Vendr portal retirement & profile transfer options

Clara 	6

Thanks for the heads up. Were opting for a hand-back + transfer manifest for BrightLeaf Health so their internal security team can ingest artifacts into their records.

Action items on our side:
- Ill be the primary point for coordination (jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com).
- Marissa: can you own generating the transfer-matrix.xlsx and mark which artifacts are originally on S3 vs attached proofs?
- Ben: please prepare the delegated roles PDF with the minimal set of access rights for the presign window.
- Irene: can you confirm whether we need any additional redaction requests before hand-back?

Wed like the hand-back window to be May 12-14 (UTC) if that aligns with your schedule. If not, propose alternatives. Please include the signed manifest and the URL/TTL for any presigned S3 objects.

Jordan
Director, Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference
[autosignature: +1 415-555-0192]

From: Clara Li <clara.li@vendr.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: support@vendr.com
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 08:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming Vendr portal retirement & profile transfer options

Jordan,

Confirming we can do hand-back May 12-14 UTC. We will:

- Prepare a signed transfer manifest (PDF) with MD5 checksums for each artifact.
- Provision a temporary presigned-bucket with 48-hour TTL for downloads.
- Provide an audit log export covering last 24 months (CSV) as part of the bundle.

Two notes:
1) For compliance reasons we require the receiving steward to acknowledge receipt and complete a short evidence acceptance form (link below) within 72 hours.
2) If you require any redaction, please provide a list of object keys or indicate which artifact types to strip.

Ive attached the migration manifest template and a sample signed-manifest we used for a similar hand-back.

Attachments: transfer-manifest-template.pdf, sample-signed-manifest.pdf
Links: https://vendr.com/portal/migration-guide

Thanks,
Clara
Vendor Integrations — Vendr
[attachment: transfer-manifest-template.pdf (pdf)]
[attachment: sample-signed-manifest.pdf (pdf)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Clara Li <clara.li@vendr.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, security@brightleaf.com
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 15:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming Vendr portal retirement & profile transfer options

Hi Clara,

Thanks 	6 appreciate the flexibility. Quick status from our side after a short internal sync:

- We will accept the hand-back window May 12-14 UTC.
- Attached is the transfer-matrix.xlsx that maps each Vendr artifact to our ingestion fields; column G marks objects that require PII-redaction (none for this set).
- Delegation-roles.pdf lists two stewards: jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com (primary) and ben.carter@redwoodinference.com (backup). Ben will be on-call during the presign window.
- Irene confirmed we dont need redactions for these artifacts; we only ask that checksums be provided.

Next steps for Vendr: please provision the presigned bucket and share the signed manifest by May 10 so BrightLeaf can schedule an ingestion task. BrightLeaf security (ccd) will fill the acceptance form once they verify checksums.

Attachments: transfer-matrix.xlsx, delegation-roles.pdf

Jordan/Ben/Irene 	6 Ill follow up with a short runbook for the presign-download-verify-accept flow and block a 30-min verification call on May 13 at 16:00 UTC; Ben please confirm availability.

Marissa Cole
Technical Programs Manager — Redwood Inference
